gates.evidence: The offer is presented on the Daily Checkin Dialog for a standard story/character companion app featuring SFW characters like The Midnight Library.
Reward is for playing a 15-second rewarded mini-game, not for clicking an ad or installing an app; credits are in-app non-cash currency.
Uses gain framing ('Play a quick 15-second game to earn 10 extra credits.') with no fake timers, confirmshaming, or loss threats.
The offer card provides an explicit CTA button ('Play Now').
The offer body explicitly states the required action and reward: 'Play a quick 15-second game to earn 10 extra credits.'
Includes a clear decline option ('No thanks') that leaves the app fully usable without penalty.
Triggered on the Daily Checkin Dialog after claiming daily check-in, not during an active chat stream.
Eligibility specifies 'Non-paying guests who have completed their daily check-in'.

scores.evidence: Applies TAX-5 (multiplier/bonus post-action) right after the daily check-in claim on s01, aligning the bonus directly with the check-in habit.
Appears as an optional post-claim card on s01 using Simula's SIM-RWD unit with Game Partner 'The Midnight Library', preserving core flow and adding no interruption.
Limited to 1 per day for non-paying users, granting 10 credits (worth ~$0.014), which aligns closely with a single view value and is vastly below purchase packs ($1.39 for 1,000 credits).
Code confirms cost to serve per view ($0.0018) is well below net revenue per view, and reward value ($0.0139) is 0.93x a view.
Occurs at daily check-in completion (m4), which has frequent reach among returning daily users, though limited to once per day per user.
Directly maps to Simula SIM-RWD unit with button entry, Game Partner, REWARD_VERIFIED grant, and standard patch components.
References exact digest elements: screen s01 (Daily Checkin Dialog), resource r1 (Credits), source src1 (Daily check-in), and Game Partner 'The Midnight Library'.
Caps at 1 per day with a 1,440-minute cooldown and a clean decline path.
Defines primary metric (Rewarded ARPDAU), clear guardrails (purchase conversion, retention), and a 5% user-level holdout for 28 days.

parsed.topConcern: None; proposal is exceptionally well-aligned with the product model, economics, and Simula specs.
